title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - LivingOrganism
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/LivingOrganism. Any entity composed of cells; the generic SAREF4WEAR actor that can be equipped with a wearable device, before it is specifically known to be sensed by one (at which point it is more specifically a Wearer). Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). Covers humans as well as other organisms (e.g. livestock or pets fitted with animal wearables), which the ontology leaves open.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LivingOrganism'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Model:'https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Point'. Current geolocation of the living organism (it is a subclass of geo:Feature).
